zh: 声音清单无效，已安静跳过。
en: The sound manifest is invalid. Audio was safely skipped.

zh: 音乐目录清单无效，音乐暂不可用。
en: The music catalog is invalid. Music is unavailable.

zh: 声音偏好暂时无法保存。
en: Sound preferences could not be saved.

zh: 部分声音未播放 · 请检查开关和音量
en: Some sounds did not play. Check switches and volume.

zh: 等待停止的消息已满，输入保留。
en: The queue waiting for Stop is full. Your input is kept.

zh: 正在停止主动回合，确认后发送你的消息。
en: Stopping the autonomous turn. Your message will be sent after confirmation.

zh: 连接对象未建立，请先聊一句以连接。
en: No connection exists yet. Send a message first to connect.

zh: 连续%d次失败，主动运行已停用：%s。重新开启后重试。
en: After %d consecutive failures, autonomy was disabled: %s. Turn it on again to retry.

zh: 未配置单价，可在居民连接中关闭。
en: No unit price is configured. You can turn this off in Resident Connections.

zh: 自主行为配置无效，已禁用。
en: Autonomy settings are invalid. Autonomy is disabled.
The player returned to the game.

zh: 家园花圃真实完工，新菜谱已解锁。
en: The homestead flowerbed is complete and a new recipe unlocked.
Day %d has begun on the island.

zh: 空闲自省：依据真实现状决定是否需要行动，也可以保持安静。
en: Idle reflection: decide whether an action is needed from real current facts. Staying quiet is also valid.

zh: 做菜时限或鱼份数配置无效。
en: Cooking time limits or fish portions are invalid.

zh: 吧呀啊嘛呢哦了一下点些满上把给我去帮你们们的。，、！!？?～~
en: Chinese command filler characters (kept unchanged for parsing)

zh: 附近还没有能用的田，先把田开出来吧。
en: There are no usable fields nearby. Build a field first.
